name: nr-restart
description: Restart flagged services on one or several hosts in one run.

parameters.name: Hosts
parameters.description: Host(s) to run on. The Services list refreshes from a fresh scan of the selection.

parameters.name: Services
parameters.description: host:service entries to restart. Usually prefilled from the needrestart report. Empty selection = only a dry run, or a real restart of ALL flagged services if 'Allow all' is ticked.

parameters.name: Allow all
parameters.description: Safety switch: with an EMPTY Services selection, a real restart of ALL flagged services on every selected host is only allowed when this is ticked. Dry run never needs it.

parameters.name: Exclude
parameters.description: Optional: regex of services to exclude on every host (can use alternation, e.g. `^dbus|^rsyslog`).

parameters.name: Action
parameters.description: Restart is preselected; pick dry run to only preview.

values_ui_mapping.dry-run: Dry run (show what would be restarted)
